[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff]📰 [u]Hack Forum News - Edition 72[/u] 📝[/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to another Hack Forum News edition. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.

This week we are back to our normal look again, we hope everyone enjoyed our special edition last week.[/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2745296]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6334985][color=#ffffff]Golden Scratcher Award Goal[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

A brand new site award is now available for members feeling lucky on the forum. To earn the Golden Scratcher award you will need to head over to the scratch card section and play 10 paid scratchers over the course of the past year. Have you managed to unlock the new award for your profile yet and do you plan on testing your luck on the scratch cards anytime soon?

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6335223][color=#ffffff]Inactive Sellers [Report Reason][/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Members browsing the Marketplace can now help clean up abandoned sales threads thanks to a brand new report option. If you come across a listing where the seller is no longer responding you can report the threads first post under the Inactive Seller reason prompting Stanley to send the thread owner a private confirmation link. Sellers will have 48 hours to confirm their listing is still active or the thread will be automatically closed during the daily 2 a.m maintenance task. Do you think this new automated cleanup system will help keep the Marketplace organized?

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6335255][color=#ffffff]Paid Stickies Page[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Paid advertisements has officially made its return to the site after undergoing necessary fixes. Accessible directly from the Extras page the revamped tool allows members to view all active Paid Stickies in one spot along side a brand new Paid Sticky queue that displays pending placements and their scheduled ETAs. This update should make tracking up coming dates much easier for buyers who want to check exactly when their sticky goes live. Do you find having a dedicated queue tracker useful for monitoring sticky rotations or have you already used the tool to check on your own active placements?

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6334991][color=#ffffff]25k Scratchcard (Max win 1,000,000 Bytes)[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

High rollers looking to test their luck on the forum now have a brand new option available in the scratch card section. Members can head over to the purchase page to pick up the newly introduced 25k Bytes scratchcard for a shot at even bigger payouts. Have you already taken a gamble on the new 25k yet or are you sticking to the lower stakes for now?

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Celebrate Every Moment[/size][/b][/color]

Life isn't only about overcoming challenges and fighting through difficult times. It's also about recognizing the beautiful moments along the way, appreciating how far we've come, and allowing ourselves to enjoy the happiness we sometimes forget to notice.

Celebration doesn't always have to mean something big. Sometimes it's a personal achievement, a small victory, a new beginning, or simply making it through a difficult week with a smile. Every step forward deserves recognition, no matter how small it may seem.

Don't wait until everything is perfect to celebrate. Life is made up of little moments worth appreciating, people worth being grateful for, and memories worth holding onto.

Take a moment to be proud of yourself. Celebrate your progress, share your happiness, and remember that you deserve to enjoy the good moments just as much as you endure the difficult ones.

Because life isn't just about surviving the journey. It's also about enjoying it.

[hr]

[color=#FF851B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]

Don't let the pursuit of bigger achievements make you overlook the little victories. Celebrate your progress, appreciate the people around you, and never feel guilty for being happy. Every reason to smile is worth celebrating.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]

“Enjoy the little things in life, for one day you may look back and realize they were the big things.”

— Robert Brault
